definitions.gloss: affixing a seal; stamping; putting one's seal
definitions.explanation: The act of stamping or affixing a personal seal (hanko/inkan) on a document. In Japan, seals are used instead of or in addition to signatures on official documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押印|おういん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please affix your seal to the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧{押印|おういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧、ご⟦{返送|へんそう}→返送：07344_hensou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sign, stamp, and return the document.

examples.japanese: {押印|おういん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朱肉|しゅにく}→朱肉：06192_shuniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use red ink pad for stamping.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push/stamp) + {印|いん} (seal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {押印|おういん} - formal term for seal stamping
- ⟦{捺印|なついん}→捺印：08014_natsuin⟧ - also means affixing a seal (more formal)
- {判|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ - casual way to say "stamp one's seal"

SEAL CULTURE IN JAPAN:
Seals (⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧/⟦{判子|はんこ}→判子：00089_hanko⟧) have traditionally been used in Japan instead of signatures for:
- ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧ - contracts
- ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧ - applications  
- {届|とど}け{出|で} - notifications
- {受領書|じゅりょうしょ} - receipts

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧{押印|おういん} - signature and seal
- {押印欄|おういんらん} - seal impression box (on forms)
- {押印|おういん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧/⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ - with/without seal required

MODERN TREND:
Due to digitalization, many companies and government offices are moving toward reducing {押印|おういん} requirements. This is called {脱|だつ}ハンコ or ハンコレス.
